entities.summary: Fumane Cave is a dolomite cave within the Fumane Valley in the Province of Verona, Italy, which was formed in the Neogene period. The cave contains rich evidence of three prehistoric hominid cultures: Mousterian, Uluzzian and Aurignacian. Additionally, the cave has some of the oldest cave art that has been discovered in Europe.
